warning_texts: Both test claims record alpha 0.05 with bonferroni as the correction but never state the adjusted per-test alpha (0.025). The conclusion does not change because both p-values are effectively zero, but the correction is named rather than shown to be applied.
Both test p-values are stored as 0.0000000000 with display_digits 4, so a surface would print p = 0.0000; the release should render this as below 0.0001 rather than as an exact zero.

The CLM-COMPLETION-* caveats do not say in words that cancelled and pending orders are in the denominator. The recompute confirms they are (the denominators 24597 and 19934 are the whole channel), but a reader of the caveats cannot tell.
The machine gate has no rule over the prose of analysis/answers/*.json or over caveat topics beyond the required list. Both blockers above sit in that unchecked space and were found only by reading.

shipping_total (37792722.50 EUR) is more than twelve times net revenue. That is consistent with the per-row shipping values in the export, but because the total is excused and never published, no claims-stage rule checks its locale parsing.
